title: Compiler error E0277 in test assertions
prompt: What causes error E0277 when invoking assert_eq! on a custom struct?
answer: Error E0277 occurs when the type being compared lacks either the Debug or PartialEq trait implementation. assert_eq! requires PartialEq to compare values and Debug to display them when the assertion fails. Adding derive(Debug, PartialEq) to the struct definition resolves the error.
